profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer| Python, Java | GCP, Kubernetes
profile.summary:
As a senior software engineer, I bring extensive experience in delivering scalable, high-performance B2B and SaaS solutions. I am passionate about writing code, taking ownership of projects, and leading innovative solutions to address the world's most pressing challenges. Mentoring emerging engineers is a source of great fulfillment for me, and I am deeply committed to using my skills to support ethical causes.

My primary expertise is building Python backend services, leveraging frameworks such as Django, FastAPI, and Flask. Additionally, I have a solid professional background in Rust and Java. Throughout my career, I have successfully addressed complex challenges, leading the charge on projects that bring millions in revenue. I believe in simplicity and delivering high-quality projects that adhere to industry best practices, including automated testing and deployment.

I thrive in collaborative environments where I can learn from my colleagues and contribute to collective success. I am passionate about recognizing and nurturing the unique strengths in others, creating spaces where those strengths can truly shine. Having benefited from valuable mentorship early in my career, I am dedicated to paying it forward by helping to guide and develop the next generation of engineers. I enjoy identifying opportunities to improve team processes, fostering efficiency and enhancing engineering culture.

projects.title: Torna.dog
projects.description:
Independently designed, developed, and launched a full-stack web application that provides weather forecasts tailored for storm chasers, improving public safety by placing spotters closer to severe weather events.

Developed a fully custom and performant atmospheric model using Rust, enabling the product to run on low cost servers

Back end service written in Django, handling orchestration and serving using Apache and server side rendering

Automated GIS processing of NWS weather data using GDAL and Python bindings

Statistical evaluation and research using Pandas and Matplotlib

Cloud deployment to Hetzner Cloud using Docker
